evals.name: mode-C-quick-training
evals.prompt:
Git: https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/somunslotus/egnn.git  分支 master
数据集: C:\data\gnn_train_ori_data.zip
模型: C:\data\final_model.ckpt
evals.expected_output: Agent should immediately login() then call prepare_quick_training() with the provided Git/file paths, without asking about mode A/B/C. Should present hyperparams table + image list in one message, then validate and run.

assertions.name: no-mode-ask-question
assertions.text: Agent does NOT ask '选 A/B/C' or '哪种训练方式' — recognizes Git URL + local file as Mode C and proceeds directly

assertions.name: calls-prepare-quick-training
assertions.text: Agent calls prepare_quick_training with git_url, git_branch, dataset_file_path, and model_file_path from the user prompt

assertions.name: presents-hyperparams-table-once
assertions.text: Agent presents hyperparams_table as a single complete table (not split across multiple messages)

assertions.name: presents-image-list-for-user-selection
assertions.text: Agent calls list_training_images and presents the list for user to select

assertions.name: no-ask-resource-type-spec
assertions.text: Agent does NOT call list_resource_types or list_resource_specs in Mode C — uses draft values from prepare_quick_training

evals.name: mode-C-no-pretrain-model
evals.prompt: 跑个训练，Git地址是 https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/somunslotus/egnn.git master分支，数据集文件在 C:\data\train_data.zip，没有预训练模型
evals.expected_output: Agent should identify Mode C, call prepare_quick_training without model_file_path, auto set skip_pretrain_model=true, and not ask about pre-training.

assertions.name: mode-c-without-pretrain
assertions.text: Agent recognizes Git URL + dataset file (no model file) as Mode C without pre-training

assertions.name: no-ask-pretrain
assertions.text: Agent does NOT ask user whether to use pre-training when no model_file_path is provided

assertions.name: skip-pretrain-auto
assertions.text: Agent automatically sets skip_pretrain_model=true in the training params

evals.name: mode-a-step-by-step
evals.prompt: 我想用我之前创建的代码配置和数据集跑个训练任务，帮我一步步配置吧。我的代码是 'atom-train'，数据集是 'GNN-DATA'，要选 v3 版本。资源用 GPU 的 A100 规格。镜像用默认的 pytorch 那个。启动文件是 train.py，输出目录 /result。不需要预训练模型。
evals.expected_output: Agent should follow Mode A step-by-step flow: login, code_query to confirm atom-train, dataset_query to confirm GNN-DATA, dataset_get_version_list to pick v3, list_resource_types, list_resource_specs for A100, list_training_images, ensure_export_model auto-create, validate, then run.

assertions.name: follows-step-by-step
assertions.text: Agent follows Mode A sequential steps, confirming each selection with user before proceeding

assertions.name: calls-ensure-export-model
assertions.text: Agent calls ensure_export_model (or uses auto-create in run_training_pipeline) without asking user for export model name

assertions.name: no-skip-validate
assertions.text: Agent calls validate_training_params before run_training_pipeline

assertions.name: shows-personal-first
assertions.text: Agent queries personal resources first (is_public=false or not specified) before asking if user wants public resources

assertions.name: entry-command-relative-path
assertions.text: Agent accepts train.py as relative path, does NOT prepend 'python ' or 'bash '

evals.name: mode-b-existing-workflow
evals.prompt: 帮我用我之前保存的流水线 'my-standard-training' 跑个实验吧，实验名叫 test-run-001，超参把 lr 改成 0.0001 就行
evals.expected_output: Agent should call list_workflows, find 'my-standard-training', get_workflow_detail, confirm params, and call create_and_run_experiment.

assertions.name: calls-list-workflows
assertions.text: Agent calls list_workflows to show available workflow templates (not asking for workflow_id)

assertions.name: not-ask-workflow-id
assertions.text: Agent does NOT ask user for workflow_id — uses list + name search instead

assertions.name: calls-get-workflow-detail
assertions.text: Agent calls get_workflow_detail to show current params before asking user to confirm

assertions.name: uses-create-and-run-experiment
assertions.text: Agent calls create_and_run_experiment (not run_training_pipeline) for Mode B

assertions.name: partial-params-override
assertions.text: Agent only overrides lr=0.0001 in global_params_json, keeping other params from the template

evals.name: polling-and-output
evals.prompt:
Git: https://openi.pcl.ac.cn/somunslotus/egnn.git 分支 main
数据集: C:\data\train.zip
evals.expected_output: Mode C flow then polling: after run_training_pipeline, Agent should show launch_summary immediately, poll periodically, and show completion summary.

assertions.name: shows-launch-summary
assertions.text: Agent immediately shows launch_summary table after run_training_pipeline returns

assertions.name: polls-with-offset
assertions.text: Agent calls poll_training_progress with last_status and log_offset tracking

assertions.name: shows-completion-summary
assertions.text: Agent shows completion_summary when should_continue=false with status, duration, output files, and export model info
